answer: Each epoch auctions fixed slots: applicants bid a bond, only the top bids win, so 100 fake identities must outbid 100 honest agents. The cost delta is decisive: at 400 POA per slot, 100 fakes cost 40,000 POA, while one honest agent pays once and earns it back in 20 epochs. Losing bids forfeit a 5% copper fee, burned at once, killing bid spam. Honest agents climb the ridge once; fakes re-enter every epoch at full price, no bulk discount.
